program: Developer Pathway Program: additional technical-assistance project-year
status: Conditional research model; actual regional program, hypothetical additional SF project
interpretation: Illustrative central and stress scenarios, not a calibrated expected value, confidence interval, priced offer or recommendation.

recipient.note: Memberships default to c4 unless requested otherwise. Do not represent a c3 gift as purchasing c4 advocacy. HAC and Onyx share delivery; count one project pathway.

verified_program_facts.geography: Nine Bay Area counties or Sacramento County
verified_program_facts.caveat: Fees are not full service costs; service value is not expenditure; participant hours are not provider hours; selection cap is not completed participants or SF projects.

unit: One hypothetical additional year of technical support for an identified SF housing project, including failed efforts; not a membership scholarship or construction grant.

cost_perspective.price_basis: September 2026 analyst planning allowances, not quoted or audited costs
cost_perspective.cost_judgment: All hours, rates and allowances are judgments. Favorable/unfavorable budgets are 0.5x/2x the central allowance, not observed scale effects. Recruitment and failed effort must fit this whole-place budget; any omitted delivery expense must be added.
unpriced_resources: Incremental development and land opportunity costs
Public subsidies and public delivery resources
cost_perspective.resource_note: Full-resource comparison is unpriced, not zero. Include net incremental real resources against the same counterfactual, distinguish transfers and financing from resource costs. Private construction capital is neither a free input nor a donor expense.

input_definitions.net_sf_homes_H: Conditional project net homes after demolition, replacement and offsetting construction; not all endorsed units.
input_definitions.incremental_completion_probability_p: Difference in completion probability caused by additional support, conditional on genuinely additional delivery. Includes financing and other-provider counterfactual; do not multiply by another realization probability.
input_definitions.funding_additionality_a: Probability/fraction that gift expands services beyond existing Sobrato support, fees and substitute funding; not a second attribution haircut on already donor-attributed outcomes.
input_definitions.health_affected_people_per_net_home: Judged people experiencing health-relevant housing improvement per net added home, not total occupants or all people escaping homelessness.
input_definitions.net_annual_utility_change: Signed judgment, net of shared displacement, construction and other health harms; not a measured DPP utility effect.
input_definitions.discounted_incremental_health_years: Finite incremental health exposure after completion, already discounted to gift date; not program duration, building life or observed follow-up.
input_definitions.donor_specific_harm_qalys: Separate donor-caused health harm independent of service expansion. Do not use for shared intervention harms or financial opportunity cost already counted in cost.

time_bridge.calendar_interpretation_only: At 3% annual discount and benefit starting at year 3, E=5 corresponds to 5.958932811498 years of subsequent health benefit ending at year 8.958932811498; E=2 corresponds to 2.259238871764 years ending at year 5.259238871764. These are implied illustrative durations, not evidence or extra multipliers. The core retains accepted E inputs.
time_bridge.catch_up_rule: If support only accelerates otherwise inevitable construction, restrict exposure to occupied resident-years before counterfactual catch-up. For later actual completion or shorter health persistence, recompute E rather than retaining five years automatically. No benefit before completion.

formulas.cost_per_10_qalys: 10 * donor_cost_usd / incremental_qalys, only when incremental_qalys > 0; otherwise null with explicit null/harm status
